newsitem.title: USA: Becton Dickinson files $300 mln debt shelf.
newsitem.headline: Becton Dickinson files $300 mln debt shelf.

text.p: Becton Dickinson and Co filed Tuesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf registration to sell up to $300 million in debt securities and warrants.
Net proceeds will be added to the general funds and may be used to repay outstanding debt and to meet capital expenditure and working capital requirements, the company said.

The company, based in Franklin Lakes, N.J., manufactures and sells a broad line of medical supplies and devices and diagnostic systems used by health care professionals, medical research insititutions and the general public.
